details:
When trying to launch VRChat, I sometimes get greeted with the error "Failed to connect to VRChat. Verify connection and try again."

The log file then contains this error:

2026.07.30 19:32:59 Error      -  VRCCertificatePolicy: certificate verification failed for requestHost , cert subject CN=*.photonengine.io, cert public key , cert issuer CN=RapidSSL TLS RSA CA G1, OU=www.digicert.com, O=DigiCert Inc, C=US
